problem_title: Two Sum II – Input Array Is Sorted
input_contract: Input is a dictionary with keys 'nums' (a list of integers sorted in non-decreasing order) and 'target' (an integer). Return a list of two 0-indexed indices of the two numbers that add up to target; if no solution exists, return an empty list.

variants.name: Two Pointers
variants.strategy: Use left and right pointers moving inward based on comparison of current sum with target.

variants.name: Hash Map
variants.strategy: Store each number's index in a hash map and instantly check whether the complement exists.

pseudocode: For each num, compute complement = target - num
If complement in map, return indices
